title: Web of Things Working Group recharter: New momentum for IoT interoperability
summary: The Web of Things (WoT) Working Group rechartered for two years to improve IoT interoperability and address physical AI use cases. WoT counteracts fragmentation in IoT by providing building blocks that enable seamless device integration across smart buildings, industrial automation, and energy management. Drawing on Plugfest insights, the new charter focuses on enhancing Thing Description expressiveness, introducing protocol bindings, and guiding AI agents.
